create_commsPerfMetrics: create a commsPerfMetrics dataclass instance to store base communication operation performance metrics
create_commsCollPerfMetrics: create a commsCollPerfMetrics dataclass instance to store collective communication latency and bandwidth metrics
create_commsPt2PtPerfMetrics: create a commsPt2PtPerfMetrics dataclass instance to store point-to-point communication bandwidth metrics
create_commsQuantCollPerfMetrics: create a commsQuantCollPerfMetrics dataclass instance to store quantized collective communication latency metrics
register_perf_logger: register a custom commsPerfLogger subclass instance in the global customized_perf_loggers dictionary
